purpose: Teach: 櫻井/杉本/鳩山/齋藤/佐伯/中谷/中井/川島

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 櫻井部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the welcome reception for Director Sakurai.
lines.style: Brisk, organized tone. Quick clip on the opening. Professional but not stiff. Moving through the list with quiet momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。杉本課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check Manager Sugimoto's handover notes.
lines.style: Affirming without fanfare. Efficient nod in the voice. Light, responsive rhythm. Note-taking energy — already moving to the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 政界の鳩山系列の動向を社内で共有しましょう
lines.en: We should share the latest on the Hatoyama faction's movements with the team.
lines.style: Clear directive, slightly elevated importance. Measured pace. Slight lean forward in tone — this matters. Professional attention, not just routine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。齋藤広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll check Saito from PR on this month's planning documents.
lines.style: Smooth confirmation. Steady, reliable pace. No hesitation — just competent forward motion. The rhythm of someone who tracks multiple streams easily.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 佐伯顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a meeting with Advisor Saeki.
lines.style: Direct instruction, calm authority. Even pace. Slight finality on the endpoint. Not pushy — just clear about what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中谷経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the fiscal closing timeline with Accounting.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment. Smooth handoff energy. Each clause lands with quiet precision. Someone threading through multiple dependencies without strain.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中井人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask HR to prepare a new-hire training plan.
lines.style: Directive with collaborative tone. Mid-pace, not rushed. Slight warmth underneath the instruction — involving people, not just tasks. Clear and reasonable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。川島法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: I'll request a contract review from Legal on the new agreements.
lines.style: Final note in a sequence. Solid, closing rhythm. Clean acknowledgment — the last piece settling into place. Professional wrap without drama.
